info.title: VTSA CSMS Platform API
info.description: Versioned platform API including identity, tenancy, public station discovery, and asset administration.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Public liveness and readiness probes for infrastructure automation.

tags.name: Identity
tags.description: First-party mobile authentication, verification, invitations, and devices.

tags.name: Sites
tags.description: Tenant- and assignment-scoped site directory and reporting foundation.

tags.name: Public Stations
tags.description: Public-safe discovery backed by PostGIS proximity and bounds queries.

tags.name: App Configuration
tags.description: Public, cacheable, non-secret client rendering recommendations.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Tenant- and site-scoped charging-station administration and data transfer.

tags.name: Charging
tags.description: Tenant- and site-scoped charging sessions, command orchestration, review, and CDR evidence.

tags.name: Tariffs
tags.description: Versioned tariff definitions and immutable published pricing rules.

tags.name: Procurement
tags.description: Tenant-scoped requisition, sourcing, purchase-order, vendor-invoice, and three-way-match workflows.

tags.name: Inventory
tags.description: Warehouse-scoped stock custody, immutable movements, reservations, transfers, counts, and work-order parts.

tags.name: Maintenance
tags.description: Tenant- and site-scoped incidents, work orders, evidence, technician activity, and maintenance reporting.

tags.name: Payment Webhooks
tags.description: Signature-verified provider callbacks with tenant-bound destination identifiers and replay protection.

tags.name: Wallet
tags.description: Verified driver prepaid balances and idempotent QR Ph top-ups.

Cancel an unsent start or record cancellation pending charger confirmation
post.description: Idempotent. Unsent requests cancel and release reserved funds. A dispatched request persists cancellation_requested and retains its hold; the monitor requests Stop once a transaction ID is known. A successful response is not proof of physical cancellation. Authoritative rejection or final transaction evidence resolves payment.

ChargingAccountSelector.name: X-Charging-Account-ID
ChargingAccountSelector.description: Explicit charging account ULID. Missing selects the original personal scope. An inaccessible or unfunded shared account never falls back to personal funds.

TenantSelector.name: X-Tenant-ID
TenantSelector.description: Optional selector that must equal the tenant bound to the credential.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable caller intent key; reuse returns the original command and session.

TooManyRequests.description: The caller exceeded the applicable rate limit.

Unauthenticated.description: The token is missing, invalid, expired, or revoked.

Forbidden.description: Current tenant, role, scope, verification, or token abilities do not permit the action.

ChargingCommandAccepted.description: Command intent was accepted for asynchronous delivery.

CorrelationId.description: ULID correlating related work across service boundaries.

qr_content.description: EMV QR content only for a pending unexpired live order; never a payment URL.

id.description: Selected prepaid account ULID; null before its first funding.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for day/time rules

time_basis.description: New time tariffs count only metered energy-flow seconds.

operational_status.description: Preferred display status. Unlike legacy availability, unavailable does not imply loss of connectivity.

connection_status.description: Recent authenticated station communication, independent of connector availability

last_seen_at.description: Last observed station communication in UTC

reported_status.description: Detailed device status; null when disconnected, stale, replaced or superseded by orchestration.

ocpp_password.description: Set or rotate the station's OCPP Basic credential; never returned. Used only by legacy Basic-auth mode; not needed for URL-only registration.

amount_minor.description: PHP minor units per session reservation; zero blocks starts, not a monthly allowance.

cancellation_requested.description: A durable customer cancellation awaits charger confirmation; it does not mean stopped or funds released.
